name: core.openwop.agents.devops-crew
description: DevOps crew. Planner decomposes a runbook into safe ordered steps → executor performs http step actions (fs / queue / crypto steps run through the enclosing workflow's nodes, not conversational tools) → verifier confirms desired state via read-only http checks.
author: OpenWOP Working Group

agents.label: DevOps Planner
agents.description: Reads a runbook or operational goal (supplied in the task payload), decomposes into safe ordered steps (with pre-checks, action, post-checks), flags steps requiring human approval, dispatches executor. Reasons over the provided text; holds no conversational tools.

agents.label: DevOps Executor
agents.description: Executes one runbook step at a time. Performs http step actions as specified by the planner; refuses steps whose action tool is outside its allowlist. Halts on first failure or unexpected state.

agents.label: DevOps Verifier
agents.description: Runs read-only http checks to confirm that the desired post-state holds after executor steps. Returns pass/fail per check with evidence.
